_comment: Per-plugin overrides for delivery scenarios. Set enabled:false to exclude a plugin (source plugins are tree-shaken at build time; bundle plugins are simply not fetched). Adding a plugin requires NO entry here - drop the folder into plugins/ and it is auto-discovered. Bundle plugins (registry-center / orchestration-center / ontology-demo) are registered in portal/src/plugins.config.js. The orchestration-center source plugin (added in #8) is superseded by its bundle counterpart and disabled pending the source-vs-bundle call in review.
